This [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''warrior''' was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chashima]] during the latter years of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> he was the largest member and leader of a group of Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]] that pursued [[Estoric Sandskimmer]] and [[Hohass Ekwesh]], members of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], as they escaped from a [[Shaper caste|shapers']] compound on the planet with a [[Mission to Chashima|stolen]] [[commbuzzer]], a bioweapon that the Yuuzhan Vong planned to use against the Galactic Alliance. The warriors threw [[Nang hul|thud bugs]] at the fleeing Wraiths, striking Sandskimmer and causing him to fall to the ground and drop the bioweapon, allowing the warriors to catch up to them. As Ekwesh stood his ground with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] to protect his injured companion, the leader of the warriors directed the [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong warrior (Hohass Ekwesh victim)|youngest]] warrior and the [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong warrior (Voort saBinring victim)|second largest]] warrior to engage the Wraiths as a training exercise.<ref name="MK" />

The skirmish began when the youngest warrior charged the defenseless Sandskimmer while Ekwesh threw a cloud of [[Unidentified glittering dust|glittering dust]] that temporarily blinded him. This opening allowed the second largest warrior to strike Ekwesh across the midsection with his [[amphistaff]]. Unbeknownst to the Yuuzhan Vong warriors, another Wraith Squadron commando, [[Voort saBinring]], was positioned some distance away with a [[blaster rifle]] equipped with a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]]. saBinring fired a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] at the leader, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him instantly by blowing off his head.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yuuzhan Vong leader was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the  [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
